claims.claim: This is a scrap compact audio system that is currently not functioning; sold as is for parts or recycling.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a silver/grey built-in-looking oven/stove unit labeled “MARS TAR,” not an audio system. No evidence in the report confirms it is not functioning.
Photo 0 shows “MARS TAR” on the lower front panel.

claims.claim: Buyer is responsible for pickup (Oshodi, Lagos).
claims.evidence: Location/pickup responsibility is from seller words only; not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: seller describes an audio system, but witness photos show an oven/stove unit. If you pay expecting audio parts, you may receive the wrong category.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing the full front and any label/plate that confirms the product type (audio vs oven/stove) and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the oven/stove unit only, and treat it as untested/for parts until function and exact model are confirmed.

risks.risk: Not working / unknown functionality: heating/ignition performance is not shown.
risks.proof: Video clip of power-on and a working test (showing heating/temperature rise or ignition) plus any error lights.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as non-working/for parts.

risks.risk: Power type and voltage mismatch (gas vs electric; required voltage/amperage).
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/spec label (voltage, wattage, gas type/regulator info if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incompatible/untestable until the rating plate is provided.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (trays, racks, knobs, manuals) affecting usability and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo inventory shot showing all included parts laid out (knobs, trays/racks, manuals) and a close-up of the control panel/ports.

risks.risk: Condition issues: dust/wear around door/front panel; door seal and glass integrity not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the oven door glass (no cracks) and door seal/gasket; plus a shot of hinges and latch alignment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having potential door/seal issues.

risks.proof: Video showing each heating mode selected and confirming which elements activate (or an inspection photo of elements).
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible element faults.

proof_requests: Send clear photos confirming the product type (oven/stove vs audio) and the full front view.
Provide a photo of the rating plate/spec label (voltage/wattage or gas specs) and any model/serial number.
Provide a short video showing it powering on and a heating/ignition test (or any error codes).
Provide close-ups of the oven door glass and door gasket/seal.
Show all included accessories (trays/racks/knobs/manuals) in one inventory photo.
response.reason: The witness report identifies an oven/stove labeled “MARS TAR,” while the seller claims an audio system and non-functioning status; without a working test and model/spec/rating plate, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
